inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped date report counts distinct products and concatenates the same distinct product labels in deterministic lexical order with a custom separator.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a daily catalog activity summary. Fixed activity rows include duplicate product observations across days; COUNT(DISTINCT) reports unique products while GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ... ORDER BY ... SEPARATOR) emits their ordered labels. The source table, identifiers, values, and application context are not copied.

fixture_notes: Each activity day counts unique product codes even when a product appears more than once; the concatenated list removes duplicates and orders labels alphabetically.
determinism_notes: Activity IDs, dates, product codes, grouping, aggregate ordering, and final date ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE catalog_activity (activity_id INT PRIMARY KEY, activity_day DATE NOT NULL, product_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT activity_day, COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) AS unique_products, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT product_code ORDER BY product_code ASC SEPARATOR '|') AS product_list FROM catalog_activity GROUP BY activity_day ORDER BY activity_day ASC

checks.sql: SELECT activity_day, product_code, COUNT(*) AS observations FROM catalog_activity GROUP BY activity_day, product_code ORDER BY activity_day, product_code
